lowlands.line: But my home is the lowlands
stanza: Are a home now for me
But my home is the lowlands
Where the sad-eyed prophet says that no man comes
My warehouse eyes, my Arabian drums
Should I put them by your gate?
Or, sad-eyed lady, should I wait?

timberlands.songTitle: Who Do We Think We Are
timberlands.line: See my jewels dripping on my Timberlands
timberlands.linePrev: We walk around here like we own this place
timberlands.lineNext: Stepping like a criminal, success is so imminent
